Mia_CS: Quick pulse for Greenfield — weekly usage + perf snapshot. TL;DR: tokens=1.2M last wk (+8% WoW, +14% QoQ), p95 latency=210ms (+12% WoW), error rate=0.45% (-0.05% QoQ), spend=$2.3k (-4% WoW). Any obvious causes or ops notes? cc @Rahul_Eng
telemetry-bot: automated report attached: 

Mia_CS: also seeing a small spike in 5xx errors on /v1/generate routes late Weds (around 23:00 UTC) — logs show burst of thrift timeouts.
Rahul_Eng: saw the same in infra alerts. Looks correlated with model-x rolling hot cache misses + sudden traffic bump. Replaying traces now.
Jess_AM: good to flag — renewal conversation in 6 weeks, want to avoid perceived instability. Any quick mitigation we can offer customers?
Rahul_Eng: short term: 1) enable prefix caching for high-volume routes, 2) bump reserved concurrency on model-x for their workspace, 3) add a small fallback to model-x-lite if p95 > 300ms. I can PR config for Dedicated pools.
Mia_CS: can you estimate cost delta for bumping reserved concurrency? customer ops wants cost vs. SLA tradeoff before we recommend.
Rahul_Eng: rough calc: +2 GPUs reserved (~$1.1k/wk) reduces autoscale churn and should cut p95 by ~40% in our sim. I'll confirm by EOD.
Jess_AM: meanwhile I'll draft a short enablement note for Greenfield: batching tips, invoking stream vs full response, and recommended prompt prefixes to increase cache hits. Share with them early next week.
Mia_CS: thanks — also capture the error trend in the CS health doc. I'll mark renewal risk low for now but note action items.
telemetry-bot: new anomaly: sustained p95 >200ms for 3h on 1779216000-1779226800 UTC; tag=model-x, scope=workspace:greenfield.
Rahul_Eng: agreed — prioritizing cache config. If Mia or Jess want, I can hop on quick call with their infra lead to walk through recommendations.
Jess_AM: yes please, schedule a 30m enablement session next Tue 10am PT. I'll get calendar invite once Rahul confirms availability.
Mia_CS: perfect. Can we close loop here after Rahul posts the confirmed cost delta and I update the health doc?
Rahul_Eng: will post numbers + PR by 1779370000 (EOD).
Mia_CS: appreciated — tagging this thread for weekly follow-up. :white_check_mark:
